execution: Source inspection only. Application/unit/integration/browser/CI/mutation tests were not executed by this audit.
purpose: Immutable audit input for implementing and reviewing a maintainable specification-to-test architecture. This is not itself an executable coverage gate.

status_definition.assertion-present: Applicable behavioral assertion was found for this bounded contract; not a passing run or exhaustive proof.
status_definition.partial: Existing assertion covers a subset; the remaining clause or boundary is recorded.
status_definition.missing: No applicable assertion located for an implemented contract.
status_definition.missing-negative-boundary: Positive flow exists; rejection boundary is absent.
status_definition.manual-only: Captures, metrics or human review exist without an automated pass/fail oracle for this visual contract.
status_definition.missing-gate: Documented obligation is not connected to a machine gate.
status_definition.not-enforced: GitHub enforcement was observed absent at audit time.
status_definition.spec-conflict: Specification or documentation conflicts require reconciliation.
status_definition.deferred: Unimplemented or explicitly out-of-scope feature; excluded from missing implemented coverage.
status_definition.provenance: Current specification/domain distinction; not an implemented-test deficit.
status_definition.partially-unverified: Static evidence does not establish the effective enforcement behavior.
status_definition.procedural-only: Review procedure exists without equivalent automated assurance.

field_notes.tests: Specific named cases, source anchors and actual assertions; combined observations are retained separately where the audit grouped tests.
field_notes.ci_status: Static configuration mapping, separate from execution. excluded-at-least-in-part includes settings/renderer/culling omitted by the audited PR command.
field_notes.candidate_regression: An unexecuted discriminating counterexample; never an observed surviving mutation.
field_notes.gap_or_candidate_regression: The source audit combined its limit with a possible regression; this text is not an execution result.
field_notes.specification_sources: Immutable repo sources unless a linked GitHub issue is explicitly mutable. Descriptive grouped source references retain resolved repository links when possible.

limits: Domain rows overlap and have different granularity; do not sum into unique requirement counts or coverage percentages.
